name: Measure a tool's length on the VF-2's tool setter through VPS

working.role: the pendant keys; rests on Feed Hold while the cycle runs

steadying.role: holds a steel scale against the tool for its gauge length; presses Cycle Start; otherwise rests at the side

phases.what: EDIT, then the VPS tab, PROBING, TOOL SETTING [proposed: force_n, duration_s]
Choose the cycle: Auto Length Rotating for end mills and face mills, Non-rotating for drills, reamers and taps, Length and Diameter where the diameter matters [proposed: force_n, duration_s]
Doors open, the steadying hand brings a 6 in steel scale up to the tool in the spindle
Hold the scale upright, its end against the spindle nose, and read it at the tool's tip: the approximate gauge length [proposed: force_n, duration_s, the 1/16 in]
phases.ends_on: the length read to about 1/16 in

phases.what: Key in the tool number, the gauge length and the diameter; F4, Output to MDI [proposed: force_n, duration_s]
phases.ends_on: the generated G65 line waiting in MDI

phases.what: Close both doors and start it as in vf2-controls, phases 14 to 19: the steadying hand presses Cycle Start, the working hand rests on Feed Hold [proposed: force_n, duration_s]
Hands off while the machine takes the tool to the tool setter, spins it for a rotating cycle and touches it off [proposed: duration_s]
phases.ends_on: the program ends and the tool's length offset is written

sources.ref: Haas Factory Outlet (Productivity Inc.), 'Haas Probe Training Manual: NG2 Next Generation VPS System' (CK-6/2016), OTS and 'Setting of Tool Length Offsets using VPS'
sources.gives: the OTS sets tool length offsets and measures diameters; VPS > Probing > Tool Setting, the cycle chosen by tool type, the tool number, an approximate gauge length 'measured with a scale' and the diameter keyed in, F4 to output to MDI, then run in MDI; only Probe Manual Length needs the tool jogged over the setter by hand

sources.ref: Kurt, 'Double Station Manual Vise Setup' (YouTube), measured locally with MediaPipe Hand Landmarker; borrowed, as no footage of the OTS in use was found
sources.gives: reach durations: the right hand's interquartile range, 0.32-0.67 s

notes: The tool setter the nist-ftc-10 plan names for Z: it sets each tool's length. The work Z (the part's top) still comes from a touch-off (vf2-controls) or the spindle probe. The manual is for the 2016 NG2 control; a newer NGC may name the VPS menus differently, so check against the shop's control. The doors and Cycle Start are not repeated here: phase 6 points at vf2-controls. Haas's tip on tool setters (moonshot/cards/footage/haas-tool-offsets-tool-setters.timing.json) shows manual dial setters, not the OTS, so no timing comes from it. Proposed, with reasons (phase numbers count from 1): 3 N on the keys (#1, #2, #5), 1 N holding the scale (#4) and 5 N on Cycle Start (#6, the station's proposed affordance force), since no source gives a force; reading to about 1/16 in (#4), since the manual asks only for an approximate length; every duration but the reach (#3), since the manual gives none: #1 4 s, #2 2 s, #4 3 s, #5 8 s, #6 0.3 s, #7 20-40 s for the machine's own cycle.
